acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: AppMap per-test HTTP recording https://appmap.io/docs/ , Meticulous network recording https://www.meticulous.ai/ , Sealights server-tier coverage https://docs.sealights.io/ .

Gap: the map has screens, edges and tests, but no endpoints. A backend-only change cannot reach the E2E tests that exercise it and falls back to full-suite-required.

Proposal: build an endpoint inventory from OpenAPI documents and server route dialects (rails-routes already exists). Add screen-to-endpoint edges from two sources: observed requests (redacted method plus path template) and literal client calls. Computed URLs stay UNKNOWN. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: API endpoint layer (OpenAPI/server routes, screen-to-endpoint edges) so backend changes select E2E tests
